dataset_info.name: AI_Agents_Guidebook_100_RAG_Eval_Questions
dataset_info.source: AI Agents: The Illustrated Guidebook (2025 Edition)
dataset_info.description: High-quality evaluation dataset for RAG systems built on the AI Agents illustrated guidebook. Includes factual, conceptual, code, workflow, and comparison questions across all major sections. Ideal for RAGAS, golden datasets, retriever benchmarking, and end-to-end pipeline testing.
categories: Fundamentals & What is an AI Agent
use_cases: Golden test set for fine-tuning or prompt optimization
